findings.span: SaveVideo로 최종 연장 클립을 디스크에 내보내기 합니다
findings.suggestion: SaveVideo로 최종 연장 클립을 디스크에 내보냅니다
findings.reason: "내보내기 합니다" is ungrammatical; the verb form 내보냅니다 is required.
Uses "트림" here while the extendedDescription and howToUse consistently use "트리밍" for the same operation.
Inconsistent with howToUse, which renders the same parameters as 'LoRA 가중치' and 'denoise 강도'; the same page should use one form.
Missing particle '과'; ungrammatical Korean.
'고집스러운' (stubborn in the personality sense) is unnatural when describing watermarks.
Glossary requires Preview → 미리보기, not the transliteration 프리뷰.

findings.span: 커스텀 처리 노드가 둘 다를 참조합니다
findings.suggestion: 커스텀 처리 노드가 둘 다 참조합니다
findings.reason: '둘 다를' is awkward; the object particle is unnatural here.
Hyphen between a Latin-script term and Korean is not standard Korean orthography.
'Talent casting' is rendered as 탤런트 캐스팅 in the title and 탤런트 in the FAQ, but as 인재 here (and 인물 in use cases), creating inconsistent terminology across the page.
Required product-UI translation for 'Preview' is 미리보기; 프리뷰 does not match the ComfyUI app terminology.
Required product-UI translation for 'Filename' is 파일 이름.
'dolly-in' is spelled three different ways across the page (돌리-인, 돌리 인, 돌리인); pick one consistent form.

findings.span: 반드시 인물 사진을 첫 번째 참고 이미지로 불러오세요
findings.suggestion: 인물 사진을 주 참조 이미지로 먼저 불러오세요
findings.reason: Adds emphasis ('반드시' = must, without fail) that is not present in the English source sentence.

The workflow name is transliterated in the title but kept in English ('Hairstyle Changer') in extendedDescription and howToUse, and rendered as '헤어스타일 변경 워크플로' in the description — three different forms of the same name on one page.
Third variant of the workflow name; should match the form used in the title and body text.
Glossary requires 'color' → '색상'; the description and extendedDescription correctly use '색상', so '컬러' here (and in suggestedUseCases) is inconsistent.
'selfie' is rendered '셀피' in the description and extendedDescription but '셀카' here and in the FAQ — inconsistent terminology across the same page.
Glossary requires 'custom' → '커스텀'; extendedDescription and FAQ already use '커스텀'.
Glossary requires 'Extension' → '확장'; howToUse already uses '확장', so this is inconsistent.

findings.span: ComfyUI 콘솔/로그에서 설치해야 할 저장소나 패키지명을 확인할 수 있습니다.
findings.suggestion: 설정에 표시되어 있는 경우, ComfyUI 콘솔/로그에서 정확한 저장소 또는 패키지 이름을 확인하세요.
findings.reason: Omits the conditional 'if it's indicated by your setup' and turns the instruction into a flat assertion that the name can be found.
'폴리시' is a transliteration that Korean readers parse as 'policy', not 'polish'; it is ambiguous and awkward, and the sentence already contains '다듬는'.
'fast turnarounds' means quick delivery/turnaround time, not 'iteration' (반복).
English says 'typesetting' (layout of text), which is 조판; 타이포그래피 means 'typography', a different concept.
Product-UI glossary requires 'preview' → 미리보기; the transliteration 프리뷰 is used instead.
